h: Shabbat the bride; Israel and Sarah the woman of valor

p: "a woman of valor, the crown of her husband."
And in Midrash Tanchuma on this parashah
and to Sarah who bore you."
For Abraham was the first father
"'His father' is none other than the Holy One, blessed be He,
and 'his mother' is none other than Knesset Yisrael."
the sound of his mother's footsteps,
'I will rise before the Shechinah that is coming.'"
who was the first mother of all Israel —
the whole of "A woman of valor."

h: Sarah and the field of Machpelah

p: "She considered a field and acquired it"
bought the field after her death
So how can it be expounded of her,
"She considered a field and acquired it"?
עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּזֹּהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ
according to what is written in the holy Zohar
the field of the doubling, assuredly.
The Heh in the Holy Name,
for there is in the Holy Name
the upper Heh and the lower Heh,
it is stated in the holy Zohar:
'like the fragrance of a field which God has blessed'
And this is why it says
in the manner of what Tosafos wrote
that the wife is the husband's "field"

h: Sarah merited to be Knesset Yisrael

p: to be circumcised at eight days,
the beginning of the growth of Knesset Yisrael —
"She considered a field and acquired it,"
for she merited to be Knesset Yisrael.
וְכֵן דָּרַשׁ בְּמִדְרַשׁ תַּנְחוּמָא אַחַר כָּךְ
And so Midrash Tanchuma expounds afterward:
"'From the fruit of her hands she planted a vineyard' —
'For the vineyard of the Lord of Hosts is the House of Israel.'"
Yet what connection does this have
to the beginning of the verse,
which it expounded of the field of Machpelah?
But according to what has been said, it is clear:
the Heh in the Holy Name
she merited to be Knesset Yisrael.
"From the fruit of her hands she planted a vineyard" —
for from her came forth Knesset Yisrael,
and she is the mother of the nation,
broke off its exposition of the verse,
first placing before this the exposition:
וְהוּא עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁכָּתוּב בַּגְּמָרָא
And this follows what is written in the Gemara
"A city that has everything in it —
from it come its priests, etc."
"From the fruit of her hands she planted a vineyard"
And so there is alluded in Abraham and Sarah
the Holy One, blessed be He, and His Shechinah,
as in Isaac and Rebecca afterward
(עַיֵּין סִתְרֵי תּוֹרָה לֶךְ לְךָ עט עַמּוּד ב פִּסְקָה ב
וּמִדְרַשׁ הַנֶּעְלָם פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ קכט עַמּוּד א)
and Midrash HaNe'elam on this parashah, 129a).
And this is why it expounds
"She considered a field" of the field of Machpelah:
the upper Heh and the lower Heh.

h: "She fears not snow for her household": Shabbat and milah

p: "'She fears not snow for her household.'
'For her whole household is clothed in scarlet (shanim)' —
it speaks of the fire of Gehinnom,
and here it calls it snow —
as is written in the Midrash
There is an evil inclination of desire,
which is called by the name "fire";
וְכֵן יֵצֶר הָרָע שֶׁל קִנְאָה וְכָבוֹד
and likewise the evil inclination of envy and of honor,
that these too are called fire.
And there is the husk of Amalek,
he cooled you and made you lukewarm;
And this is the beginning of the husk,
and it provokes even the great.
that the evil inclination not overpower me
For the root of the serpent and the evil inclination
sorrow and toil into the world.

h: Strength at the Sea, splendor at Sinai: the revelation of Atika

p: And this is the point of the Tanchuma's exposition:
this is the strength in which I clothed you at the Sea,
as it says, 'My strength and song,' etc.;
the splendor with which you adorned yourself through Me at Sinai, etc."
at the Sea and at Sinai
there was a revelation of Atika,
for the splitting of the Sea
as is written in the holy Zohar
And it is stated in the Mechilta
And likewise at the Giving of the Torah it is written,
that is, the revelation of Atika.
And this is the garment of "glory and splendor."
'We will do and we will hear,'
with which you adorned yourself through Me at Sinai
And at the moment they said
"We will do and we will hear,"
they were crowned with two crowns,
from the garment of "glory and splendor"
there came to be a surrounding light,

h: The Sea through teshuvah; Sinai through true goodness

p: And that it expounds "glory" as the strength
with which I clothed you at the Sea —
this is because at the Sea,
"and the waters were a wall (chomah) for them,"
there was an accusation at the Sea;
And this is "upon the face of the waters":
teshuvah, which is likened to water.
And "splendor" it expounds of the Giving of the Torah,
And from both of them there came about afterward,
at the Giving of the Torah,
And this is what it expounds:
the garment of "glory" from the Sea,
and from both they merited the surrounding light.

as is written in the holy Zohar
the Aleph bores through the darkness
and shines to every side, etc.,

p: (Berachos 31a) (one may not fill one's mouth with laughter in this world).
and laughter did not cease from his mouth
he filled his mouth with laughter.
(Yerushalmi, end of the first chapter of Berachos):
and the plague of the firstborn, etc."

in which Israel were sifted out

in the manner of what is written in the holy Zohar
And the order of the ten plagues
as is written in the holy Zohar

when he merited joining redemption to prayer,
it means he merited a revelation of Atika,
a foretaste of the World to Come;
laughter did not cease from his mouth.
